data.one_liner: Windows platform implementation of just_audio using WinRT MediaPlayer
data.what_it_does: Provides Windows audio playback support for the just_audio package. It implements features such as playing from URLs, files, and assets, as well as playlists, gapless playback, volume, and speed control.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app targeting Windows and using the just_audio package.
You need features like HLS, DASH, playlists, and gapless playback on Windows.
avoid_when: Your target platform does not include Windows.
You require features not yet implemented on Windows such as request headers or custom equalizer.
strengths: Native Windows Media Player implementation via WinRT.
Supports advanced audio features like playlists, gapless playback, and pitch/speed control.
weaknesses: Some features like request headers and ICY metadata are not documented as supported on Windows.
Byte stream reading is not tested.
data.setup_notes: Platform implementation package for Windows; usually registered automatically by federated plugin mechanisms when used alongside just_audio.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a different audio playback API for Windows without depending on just_audio.
